regulatory_bodies: MHLW (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare)
METI (Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry)

rules.name: Cosmetics vs Quasi-Drug (Iyakubugaihin) Boundary
rules.title: Cosmetics vs Quasi-Drug (Iyakubugaihin) Boundary
rules.directive_code: Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act (PMD Act) Article 2
rules.statute_citation: Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Act (PMD Act) Article 2
rules.expected_requirement: Quasi-Drug (Iyakubugaihin) pre-market approval required from MHLW/PMDA for active therapeutic, medicinal, or pharmacological claims.
rules.explanation: Japanese law strictly delineates Cosmetics from Quasi-drugs and Pharmaceuticals. Therapeutic claims are strictly prohibited for cosmetics.
rules.fix_suggestion: Tone down claims to basic skin moisturizing, cleansing, or beautifying expressions permitted under MHLW Notification No. 1339.

rules.name: Mandatory Japanese Language Labeling & Licensed In-Country Caretaker (MAH)
rules.title: Mandatory Japanese Language Labeling & Licensed In-Country Caretaker (MAH)
rules.directive_code: PMD Act Article 61 / Consumer Affairs Agency Act
rules.statute_citation: PMD Act Article 61 / Consumer Affairs Agency Act
rules.expected_requirement: Label in Japanese language with name and address of the licensed Marketing Authorization Holder (Seizouhanbaigyou).
rules.explanation: Imported cosmetics cannot be sold in Japan with English-only labels. An authorized Japanese entity holding a primary distributor license must attach a compliant Japanese label.
rules.fix_suggestion: Partner with a licensed Japanese import distributor (MAH) to attach mandatory Japanese legal labels upon arrival.

requirements.name: Japanese Legal Label (Seizouhanbaigyou)
requirements.description: Affixed Japanese language label with MAH.

rules.name: Mandatory PSE Mark Certification for Electrical Devices
rules.title: Mandatory PSE Mark Certification for Electrical Devices
rules.directive_code: Electrical Appliance and Material Safety Act (DENAN Law) / METI
rules.statute_citation: Electrical Appliance and Material Safety Act (DENAN Law) / METI
rules.expected_requirement: Circle PSE (Non-Specified Electrical Appliances) or Diamond PSE (Specified Electrical Appliances) mark and METI business notification.
rules.explanation: Electric consumer appliances and lithium-ion batteries with high volumetric energy density (>=400 Wh/L) must conform to Japanese technical standards and bear the PSE mark.
rules.fix_suggestion: Conduct testing against DENAN Ordinance Article 1 and affix the Circle PSE symbol.

requirements.name: PSE Mark Verification & METI Filing
requirements.description: Circle PSE mark and METI notification.

rules.name: Japan Food Sanitation Act (JFSA) Kitchenware & Cutting Board Safety
rules.title: Japan Food Sanitation Act (JFSA) Kitchenware & Cutting Board Safety
rules.directive_code: Food Sanitation Act (Act No. 233 of 1947), Article 18
rules.statute_citation: Food Sanitation Act (Act No. 233 of 1947), Article 18
rules.expected_requirement: Import notification must be filed with Quarantine Station; tableware and cutting boards must comply with dissolution tests for heavy metals and toxic additives.
rules.explanation: Under JFSA Article 18, wooden or synthetic food utensils and cutting boards imported for sale require inspection to ensure synthetic finishes or adhesives do not contaminate food.
rules.fix_suggestion: Submit 'Notification Form for Importation of Foods, etc.' to Ministry Quarantine Station with certified Japanese migration test results.

rules.name: Japan Toy Safety Standard (ST Mark / ST-2016)
rules.title: Japan Toy Safety Standard (ST Mark / ST-2016)
rules.directive_code: Japan Toy Association Safety Standard (ST Mark)
rules.statute_citation: Japan Toy Association Safety Standard (ST Mark)
rules.expected_requirement: Toys intended for infants and children must meet mechanical/physical safety, flammability, and chemical safety standards (ST Parts 1-3).
rules.explanation: Selling toys that fail chemical migration tests (e.g., heavy metals, phthalates, coloring matter) violates the Food Sanitation Act and consumer safety guidelines.
rules.fix_suggestion: Test through an approved laboratory to the ST Standard and affix the ST Mark.
